类 Application

java.lang.Object
Application
public class Application extends Object
Represents a TA's application for a specific job posting.

The lifecycle of an application is:

  1. PENDING — submitted, awaiting MO review
  2. SELECTED — MO accepted this applicant
  3. REJECTED — MO rejected this applicant
  4. WITHDRAWN — TA cancelled the application
The matchScore and matchSummary are populated by the scoring engine when the application is created or refreshed.
